pairs.subject: telemetry-pii-redaction
pairs.evidence: src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:557 The beforeSend hook only strips the fragment from event.request.url, so the query string and any identifier-shaped path segments leave intact, and request.query_string / request.cookies / transaction have no disposition anywhere. The inventory at the scrubber does not name these fields, so the gap is invisible to the next contributor.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:557 A partial inventory lives beside the redactor (header lines 4-11, the frame note at 565-574 with a stated pass reason for function/lineno/colno/in_app). But it lists only what is scrubbed, not every transport field: request.url query/path, request.query_string, cookies, transaction and exception.type have no scrubbed/dropped/passed disposition, and request.url's query actually passes raw.

src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:514 Both passes exist, the pattern order is numbered (lines 257-271), there is one exported set, and domain vs generic keys are split by a comment. But the key match is exact and case-sensitive, with no credential substring markers (password/token/secret/authorization; a grep found none), so extra: { accessToken: 'abc...' } survives with only a pattern pass that matches no token shape. There is also no digit-run/token pattern, and request.url is not reduced to scheme+host.

src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:223 Keyed SHA-256 (CSPRNG key, never sent), truncated to 6 bytes, tagged [id:]. The per-tab/process key is stated as a deliberate choice (lines 182-186). user.id is pseudonymised whole. Page-view routes collapse UUID segments and then run scrubPii (PageViewTracker.tsx:14 -> normalizePathname). Minor gap: no collision budget is stated next to MARKER_BYTES.

src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:487 Depth/breadth/node-budget/string caps all drop, with distinct markers (redacted-depth/-breadth/-budget/-cycle/truncated). There is a path-local cycle guard. safeScrubEvent returns a payload-free skeleton tagged scrub_failed on throw. Keyed removals are silent (no marker), and exotic objects are walked via Object.entries rather than dropped with a kind marker; both are minor.

src/lib/sentry-pii.ts:712 One shared baseSentryConfig (sendDefaultPii false, tracesSampleRate 0, fail-closed hooks) for all runtimes. Replays are set to 0 on the client. The captureExceptionScrubbed wrapper is enforced by no-raw-sentry-capture.test.ts. The gap prose is at the wrapper, but it omits request.url query and the metrics channel (Sentry.metrics attributes bypass beforeSend; analytics.ts builds them as fixed allowlists).

src/lib/sentry-pii.test.ts:152 Absence asserted on JSON.stringify output. There are per-cap cases (depth, cycle, DAG, breadth, node budget), fail-closed cases, clean-survival cases (line 85; location suite line 136), and the wrapper is exercised in sentry-pii-location.test.ts. There is no hostile record covering request.url query, which is why that leak is untested.
src/lib/analytics.ts:148 Every outbound record here is copied or constructed (error events, fixed-attribute metrics); there is no generated/composed artifact for an exclusion list to bound.
